research_genfill_v4_1_20261111 (the render-time finish, locked; PARKED 13 Nov: 09V passes, Porch, water and testwindow fail S, water fails T)
problem: The v4 LoRA draws a flat plate inside a large clipped near-white region: testwindow frame 48, 250-700 px inside the mask, the fill sits exactly at the 3.3 x white floor with structure 0.004-0.03 stops, though the source's own sky just under the clip carries 0.05. Naming the clouds in the prompt changed nothing (0.018-0.030). On water the model's detail at code 255 changes from frame to frame on still pixels (static clipped p95 0.19 EV). The stop rule of 12-13 Nov holds: no further render-time tuning; this is a training change.

hypotheses.H1_calibration_flattens: v4 trained with --calib-weight 0.5: on every code-255 pixel of frame 0 the decoded prediction's log2 luminance is compared with the truth, pixel by pixel, overshoot costing 4 x undershoot. Where the source carries no information, the per-pixel optimum of that term is a low, flat value: it trains the clipped interior towards a plate. The level is now set at render time (the v4.1 finish: a floor at 3.3 x white, the model's own level kept above it to 2 stops), so the term is no longer needed. Change: --calib-weight 0.
hypotheses.H2_few_structured_truths: Many region clips' truth inside the mask is itself smooth (a sun's glow, an even sky), so 'flat in, flat out' is often right in training. Change: the builder stores each region clip's truth structure (frame 0, mask eroded 6 px, std of log2 luminance minus its 6 px gaussian blur: the S measure on the truth) and the trainer draws region clips 1 + 3 x min(structure / 0.10 stops, 1) times as often.
hypotheses.H3_no_still_shots: Every training clip moves (camera paths on HDRIs, pans on plates), so the model is never shown that a still picture must give a still fill. Change: 35 % of region clips hold the camera still (every frame is frame 0's view) with grain, drawn for 60 % of them, still changing per frame; and a frame-to-frame term on the predicted clean latents inside the region (latent frames 1.., each step's change against the truth's), weight 1.0, at noise levels <= 0.6.
